originality.rationale: The new claim is a parameter-specific certified hyperbolicity/stability classification for all seven constructed cycles. Hu and Chen 2610.19586v1 prove seven isolated cycles and the formula P_y=exp((A+B)T-2πA), but not multiplier signs for the six noncentral cycles. Their own one central repeller is explicitly prior. Newly certified strict exterior-duration inequalities force two source intervals to be attracting and the other repelling, yielding four attracting and three repelling cycles under reflection. Source 2507.06705 treats three-zone models and hyperbolicity of one-zone regimes but its theorems do not apply to these multizone periodic profiles. General crossing differentiability and continuation are known; novelty is not asserted for them.
residual_risks: The evidence does not rule out differently named historical publications giving the same exact parameter triple and all six hyperbolic signs.
Not every older general piecewise-smooth text has been fully inspected; the exact special parameter/certified bounds remain unsupported by inspected primary claims elsewhere.

value.rationale: The new result upgrades the recently reported seven isolated periodic solutions to a structural arrangement of four robust attracting and three robust repelling solutions, while independently establishing unique hyperbolic roots in each three rational brackets. Isolated periodic solutions need not be hyperbolic, especially near grazing. The exact stability separation is needed to demonstrate the open coexistence of multiple stable forced responses, not only the isolated existence of seven distinct cycles.
